citations.claim: total energy at first violating step has drifted far from initial value
light body whips around heavy body at extreme speed during deep plunge inside softening scale
energy still near initial value just before the plunge completes

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 1/30 to 0.001 with all else identical; finer timestep resolves the deep plunge and energy stays conserved

explanation: A light body falls nearly head-on into a heavy mass, plunging to separation ~0.11, well inside the 0.3 softening length where acceleration peaks. Even with 39 substeps, the coarse outer dt=1/30 leapfrog over-integrates the violent pericenter whip (speed jumps from ~13.4 at step 29 to ~22.0 at step 30), injecting ~12.3 energy error and violating energy_conserved. Reducing only dt to 0.001 removes the violation, confirming under-resolved close encounter as cause.
vision_note: A small blue body falls toward a larger blue body across steps 27 to 29 until the two nearly touch. In step 30 the small body vanishes into the larger body leaving only one visible mass on the curved trail.
